steps: Name the environment, which also sets its scale (from a single building up to a city, region, or dimension).
Choose three traits: broad characteristics of the place rather than specific threats.
Give each trait a die. Together they form the environment's dice pool.
Write twists for each zone of the scene tracker (Green, Yellow, Red), plus any threats and challenges they introduce.

traits.guidance: Traits work mostly in the background when twists come into play, so keep them general (a characteristic of the place, not a single gadget or monster).

traitDice.default: d8, or d10 for a trait that matters more

twists.summary: Twists escalate as the scene tracker moves from Green to Red. One way to plan them is a three-stage story of the place falling apart: stable (Green), decaying (Yellow), collapsing (Red). Twists usually use the environment's Min, Mid, and Max dice, and they can hit anyone, not just heroes. Each major twist should fire at most once per scene (p. 158).

effectTypes.summary: Take a basic action against one or more targets: Attack, Boost, Hinder, Defend, or (rarely) Overcome a challenge. Bonuses and penalties can be one-use or persistent and exclusive.
Add minions or lieutenants that are allied, hostile, or neutral. New threats act starting on the next turn.
Something goes wrong and needs one or more Overcome successes to fix.
Set off a doomsday device built into the environment. Use at most one.
Show an outside entity acting on the scene without giving it a full sheet.
Combine two or more of these, splitting the three dice between the effects.

oneTarget: Use Mid + other effect using Min
Use Max + other effect using Mid
twoTargets: 2 actions using Mid then Min (one of them persistent and exclusive)
allTargets: 2 actions: Max on one then Min on others

oneTarget: 2 actions using Max (one of them persistent and exclusive)
2 actions using Max then Mid (one of them persistent and exclusive)
2 actions using Mid (both persistent and exclusive)
allTargets: 2 actions: Max on one then Mid on others

major: Add a single minion and another effect

minor: Add Min minions and another effect
major: Add Mid minions and another effect
Restore all minion threats to full strength
Add a single lieutenant and another effect
Add a single, more powerful lieutenant

minor: Add a single, more powerful lieutenant
Restore a single lieutenant threat to full strength
major: Restore all minions and lieutenants to full strength
Add a single, more powerful lieutenant and another effect
Increase the difficulty of an existing challenge

minor: Add a timed or multi-step challenge
major: Add a simple challenge and another effect

minor: Add a timed or multi-step challenge and another effect

major: Advance the scene tracker by one space
Advance the scene tracker by one space
Advance the scene tracker by one space

order: Advance the scene tracker one space.
All active environment threats act (as minions/lieutenants).

If no threats are in play, introduce a new one unlocked by the current zone; otherwise trigger an environment twist for the current zone. If no twist fits, roll the environment's dice as a basic Attack, Boost, or Hinder (environments don't Defend or Overcome).

challenges.summary: A challenge is an obstacle described in a few words, with one or more checkboxes, each cleared by a successful Overcome. Aim for about three successes and at most five. A challenge can also have a timer, conditional or mutually exclusive approaches, an outcome when it's resolved, a consequence when it's triggered, an ability it uses when it takes a turn, and suggested twists.

tiers.impact: Limited civilian impact or danger to heroes
Major civilian impact or danger to heroes
tiers.timer: Until the scene status changes (e.g. Yellow to Red)

tiers.impact: Catastrophic impact on the immediate area

doomsdayDevices.summary: A multi-success challenge with catastrophic consequences if triggered. It takes its own turns, advancing the scene tracker by a set amount each turn (one or two spaces, or to the start or end of the next zone). It may also have abilities and twists.
